name: Kamikura Nagisa
source:
Sayaka's younger sibling. Underclassman.

Notably pale and beautiful in a sickly sort of way. Nagisa has a weak heart, and can usually be found in the school infirmary. Sayaka is always fretting over Nagisa, which makes Nagisa a bit worried.
